info.name: Nginx Version Detection
author: philippedelteil
info.description: The nginx version is exposed in the Server response header.

request:
GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.net
User-Agent: Nuclei - Open-source project (github.com/projectdiscovery/nuclei)
response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Server: nginx/1.18.0
X-Powered-By: Express
Content-Type: application/json

{"service":"example-api","version":"2.9.1"}

info.name: Git Configuration Exposure
author: pdteam
info.description: The .git/config file is served, exposing the repository remote and branch layout.

response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Server: nginx/1.18.0
Content-Type: text/plain

[core]
	repositoryformatversion = 0
[remote "origin"]
	url = git@github.com:example/api.git

info.name: Apache Log4j2 Remote Code Execution
author: melbadry9
info.description: Apache Log4j2 JNDI features do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP endpoints, allowing remote code execution.

response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Server: nginx/1.18.0
Content-Type: application/json

{"results":[],"trace_id":"a41f"}

info.name: Apache Struts2 S2-045 Remote Code Execution
author: pikpikcu
info.description: The Jakarta Multipart parser in Apache Struts 2 mishandles the Content-Type header and allows remote command execution.

response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Server: nginx/1.18.0
X-Powered-By: Servlet/4.0 JSP/2.3
Content-Type: text/html

<html><body>uid=0(root) gid=0(root) groups=0(root)</body></html>

info.name: Error Based SQL Injection
author: geeknik
info.description: A database error message was returned when a single quote was appended to a parameter value.

request:
GET /api/v1/users/48219?filter=active%27 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.net
Authorization: Bearer test
response:
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Server: nginx/1.18.0
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":"You have an error in your SQL syntax near ''active''' at line 1"}
extracted-results: You have an error in your SQL syntax

info.name: Default Administrator Credentials
author: pdteam
info.description: The administrative console accepted the credential pair admin/admin.

request:
POST /admin/login HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.net
Content-Type: application/json

{"username":"admin","password":"admin"}
response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Server: nginx/1.18.0
Set-Cookie: connect.sid=s%3AQmFzZTY0U2Vzc2lvbjEyMw; Path=/; HttpOnly
Content-Type: application/json

{"token":"eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9","role":"administrator"}

info.name: Content-Security-Policy Header Missing
author: socketz
info.description: The static entry point is served without a Content-Security-Policy header.

response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Server: nginx/1.18.0
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8

<html><head><title>API docs</title></head><body>Reference</body></html>

info.name: Open Redirect
author: dwisiswant0
info.description: The next parameter is used as a redirect target without validation.

response:

Server: nginx/1.18.0
Location: https://evil.example
